_notes: Stage 6 draft written by UX Designer UX-006-06 (milestone B) at 2026-10-03T11:21:53Z (UTC from code). It holds 16 screens drawn in 23 real Stitch views (46 files). It is NOT all of Stage 6, NOT a clean control (no Stage 7 review) and NOT owner approval: the owner liked the general style of the first six views, which does not approve the interface.

Provenance per file (screen ID, prompt key, SHA-256, PNG source) is in .migration-tmp/stage-06/ux-006-01/exports/ux-006-06/provenance.jsonl and result.md. PNGs are the =w1600 size of the get_screen asset, except list-phone (official UI Export ZIP 08308ffb…0fd4) and list-desktop, form-desktop, dialog-desktop (official UI Export ZIP 827baa43…73a0).

Pending exports (consolidated UI hand-off handoff-ux-006-06-b.md): story-editor, task-page, delete-task confirmation, continue-unfinished-stories dialog, time-editor (desktop and phone), person-page (initials avatar), person-editor, aggregate-timesheet, note-editor, error-page, system-info, statistics phone, the component sheet ui-kit, and the in-place edits of list-desktop and dialog-desktop (data and page background) and form-desktop and form-phone (Reset). The current list-desktop and dialog-desktop files still show the old sample data (120.0 / 72.0 h, 40%). The current form files do not yet show Reset.

Reset (rows 81, 90, 125, 139 record Update/Reset): represented as its own neutral action restoring the initial values in project-editor and iteration-editor; edits adding it to the task editor are pending export. Cancel (return without saving) is a UX proposal not in the rows; one owner choice is recorded in result.md.

Navigation (see screen navigation entries): breadcrumbs on hierarchical pages, none at the root (projects-list currently shows a root "Top" breadcrumb, a recorded deviation); editors return to the originating page as the rows state; list position in the URL is a proposal only.

Responsive patterns (verified only where stated): list/table: priority columns, the table scrolls inside its own container, 44-48 px rows and targets; verified by real 390 px exports list-phone (a10e679d) and project-page-phone (f4a330e1); form: single column, 16 px fields, 44-48 px controls, stacked full-width buttons; verified by real 390 px exports form-phone (296b7803) and signin-phone (c5d26872); dialog: full width minus 16 px margins, stacked 48 px buttons, scrim; verified by dialog-phone (fdb44f71); detail page: heading, stacked full-width action buttons, summary, then a list/table; verified by project-page-phone (f4a330e1); board: stacked status sections per story; verified by iteration-board-phone (58e255ee); charts: charts stacked one per row with text legends; NOT verified (statistics phone export pending); time grid: one stacked block per entry; NOT verified (time-editor phone not generated). Surfaces without their own phone export rely on these patterns and are not individually verified.
Profile: initials avatar (avatar.initials) is a Stage 6 draft proposal on person-page (export pending); no photo, upload or identity integration; the profile-image state needs an owner decision.

Rows claimed only where drawn. Every other planned row and the other screens of the normalization are pending, and the 31 deferred plus 5 pending rows are listed in the normalization _notes (schema gap, backlog item 12). No component sheet is exported yet, so ui_design_system.resources is empty.
